Until tier 3, at least every second Machine Part gives one.","depositSeedCopper":"Deposit Seed (Copper)","depositSeedCopperDescription":"Hold it on your island and tap open ground to grow a Copper Deposit that never runs out. Needs Core tier 2.","depositSeedGold":"Deposit Seed (Gold)","depositSeedGoldDescription":"Hold it on your island and tap open ground to grow a Gold Deposit that never runs out. Needs Core tier 3.","depositSeedVoltite":"Deposit Seed (Voltite)","depositSeedVoltiteDescription":"Hold it on your island and tap open ground to grow a Voltite Deposit that never runs out. Needs Core tier 4.","depositSeedCoal":"Deposit Seed (Coal)","depositSeedCoalDescription":"From a Coal Deposit you picked up, or a Coal Ore vein. Hold it on your island and tap open ground to plant it there.","depositSeedIron":"Deposit Seed (Iron)","depositSeedIronDescription":"From an Iron Deposit you picked up, or an Iron Ore vein. Hold it on your island and tap open ground to plant it there.","depositSeedStone":"Deposit Seed (Stone)","depositSeedStoneDescription":"A Stone Deposit you picked up. Hold it on your island and tap open ground to plant it there.","ironHammer":"Iron Hammer","ironHammerDescription":"Mines a 3\xd73 square of stone and ore at once. Made at the Machine Bench.","beltLoader":"Belt Loader","beltLoaderDescription":"Puts items from the chest, Silo or machine behind it onto the belt. Made at the Machine Bench.","beltLift":"Belt Lift","beltLiftDescription":"Carries items up a block: belt into its side, put a belt or machine on top. Stack them to go higher. Made at the Machine Bench.","beltTunnel":"Belt Tunnel","beltTunnelDescription":"Carries items under up to 4 blocks, so belt lines can cross. Place one where items go in. Made at the Machine Bench.","chargeVault":"Charge Vault","chargeVaultDescription":"Lets your island store 8000 more power. Made at the Machine Bench.","steelBar":"Steel Bar","steelBarDescription":"Made in an Alloy Kiln. Used in Machine Hulls and the Core.","goldPlate":"Gold Plate","goldPlateDescription":"Pressed gold. Made at the Parts Bench.","machineHull":"Machine Hull","machineHullDescription":"The frame of most machines, the Starframe and the Forge Hopper. Made at the Machine Bench.","chargingPad":"Charging Pad","chargingPadDescription":"Tap it while holding your Sky Pack to charge the pack from island power. Each Starwright stage asks for some. Made at the Parts Bench.","starboreDrill":"Starbore Drill","starboreDrillDescription":"Breaks 3\xd73 in the Wilds, and whole ore veins. Mine it for Raw Iron, or put a Burner Drill on top.","stoneDeposit":"Stone Deposit","stoneDepositDescription":"Never runs out. Mine it for Messy Stone, or put a Burner Drill on top.","copperDeposit":"Copper Deposit","copperDepositDescription":"Never runs out. Mine it for Raw Copper, or put a Burner Drill on top.","goldDeposit":"Gold Deposit","goldDepositDescription":"Never runs out. Made at the Workbench.","copperBlock":"Copper Block","copperBlockDescription":"Nine Copper Bars packed into a block. Made at the Workbench.","voltiteBlock":"Voltite Block","voltiteBlockDescription":"Nine Voltite Dust packed into a glowing block. Made at the Workbench.","uraniumDeposit":"Uranium Deposit","uraniumDepositDescription":"Dense ore: 15 Raw Uranium a minute under any drill. Made at the Workbench.","pump":"Pump","pumpDescription":"Retired: break it for a Condenser.","condenser":"Condenser","condenserDescription":"Turns power into water, out of its front only: pipe it to the machines, Tanks and Water Ports that need it. Place one on open ground to start a reactor, then build what its ghost shows; the Frame along its bottom shows its status lights. Made at the Atomic Bench.","reactorPort":"Reactor Port","reactorPortDescription":"Fuel in, water in or waste out: place it in a reactor\'s wall, roof or floor and it takes the job the reactor lacks. Made at the Atomic Bench.","coolantChannel":"Coolant Channel","coolantChannelDescription":"Inside a reactor, cools the Fuel Rods it touches. Needs water. They grow back on the low branches of the pear tree at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm.","questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonGatherDescription":"Harvest Watermelon [[Watermelon]] at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm until you have 32 Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]]. Both start out in Cragrock Mines.","questSpencerDeepPurpleWaitingOn":"I\'m dreaming of a royal purple, neighbour, but Beetroot [[Beetroot]] only grows in Hearthdeep Village. Ruby at Ruby\'s Rockpile in the Hub can show you the way there!","questSpencerDeepPurpleCompleted":"Purple and gold, fit for a king! My patrol coat has spare lining, and I keep the trimmings. Take the fur to Tillie, and stay warm out there.","questAncientWoodlandName":"The Ancient Woodland","questAncientWoodlandDescription":"Some of these maples still hold ancient wood. Look for logs that sparkle, low on the trunk. Bring me 16 Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]].","questAncientWoodlandNotYet":"Not yet. Let the grove settle.","questAncientWoodlandNudge":"Timbertooth has work in the grove. Go and see him.","questAncientWoodlandErrandDescription":"Chop sparkling logs in Timbertooth Woods, behind me. Only you can see the sparkles. None near you? Try other trees.","questAncientWoodlandReminder":"{{remaining}} more Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]]. Look low on the trunks for sparkles.","questAncientWoodlandCompleted":"Good. Old wood, well cut. These leggings are made from it. Wear a helmet, chestplate, gauntlets, leggings and boots, then show Mini. ","questAllGearedUpUnavailableHint":"A moment, my friend \u2014 Mini is still polishing his horns. Return shortly.","questAllGearedUpNudge":"Lorenzo says Mini is ready to inspect your armour, over at The Badlands.","questHardenedEvidenceName":"A Hardened Hunch","questHardenedEvidenceDescription":"I\'ve had troubling reports from the far end of The Badlands. Travellers say the Zombies there have skin like rock and fists that pound the ground hard enough to throw a person off their feet. Worse, they\'ve made a camp. Zombies wander; they don\'t settle. A wise hunter learns his quarry before he draws his blade. Bring me proof, duellist!","questHardenedEvidenceErrand":"Find the Hardened Zombies camped at the far end of The Badlands and take 3 Hardened Hearts from them. Step out of the ring when they pound the ground!","questHardenedEvidenceCollect":"Defeat Hardened Zombies for 3 Hardened Hearts","questHardenedEvidenceDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 3 Hardened Hearts","questHardenedEvidenceHandInDescription":"Bring those Hardened Hearts back to me, duellist. I must see them with my own eyes!","questHardenedEvidenceReminder":"{{remaining}} more of those Hardened Hearts, duellist. If the travellers are right, I\'d rather know sooner than later.","questHardenedEvidenceCompleted":"Hard as rock, and still beating... The travellers were right. No ordinary Zombie grows a heart like this. Something out there is changing them, and I mean to find out what. Mini won\'t believe a word of it. You\'ve done the Hub a real service, duellist.","questHardenedResearchName":"Know Your Quarry","questHardenedResearchDescription":"Those Hardened Hearts have kept me up all night, duellist. Skin like rock, fists like hammers... Whatever hardens those Zombies, I mean to understand it, and perhaps to borrow it. That calls for research! Bring me samples from the Hardened Zombies, and from ordinary Zombies to compare. Do this, and I\'ll forge you something special.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentCollect":"Defeat Hardened Zombies for 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentGather":"Defeat Hardened Zombies at the far end of The Badlands for 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]. They flake off that rock-hard skin, and no other Zombie carries them.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentDeliver":"Bring the 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]] back to me for study.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Iron Fragment [[Iron Fragment]]. Only the Hardened Zombies drop them, duellist.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentCompleted":"Iron, flaked straight off their skin! But iron alone doesn\'t walk about. Something more is at work here.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainCollect":"Collect 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainGather":"Defeat Zombies in The Badlands for 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]. Any Zombie will do, though Hardened Zombies drop them more often.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainDeliver":"Bring the 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]] back to me. Whatever you do, don\'t eat them!","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Rotten Brain [[Rotten Brain]]. Any Zombie will do.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainCompleted":"Brains! Let\'s see what they\'ve been thinking.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshCollect":"Collect 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshGather":"Defeat Zombies in The Badlands for 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]], hardened or not. Hardened or not, any Zombie will do.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshCompleted":"Every sample accounted for! Keep at it, friend. That rock is starting to sweat!","questCompressionHyperDelivery":"Bring Ruby 1 Hyper Compressed Messy Stone [[Hyper Compressed Messy Stone]]","questCompressionHyperCompleted":"Ha! Heavy as a hill and twice as stubborn, and you beat it anyway. Take this Vein Chaser Pickaxe, friend. Break one stone here in the hub and the stone touching it comes tumbling out too, and so do matching ores!","questCompressionUltraName":"Ultra Crush","questCompressionUltraDescription":"You\'ve got arms like a dwarf now! Bring me 1 Ultra Compressed Messy Stone [[Ultra Compressed Messy Stone]]. It\'s a huge pile of stone, so let that Vein Chaser Pickaxe tear through it. I know you can do it.","questCompressionUltraGatherName":"Collect 59,049 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]","questCompressionUltraGather":"Mine Stone [[Stone]] at Ruby\'s Rockpile until you have 59,049 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]. It\'s heavier than a hill!","questCompressionUltraDelivery":"Bring Ruby 1 Ultra Compressed Messy Stone [[Ultra Compressed Messy Stone]]","questCompressionUltraCompleted":"Well, I never! I\'ve mined for years and never held one of these. Take this Compactor Pickaxe, friend. Stone [[Stone]] you dig here in the hub comes out already squashed, and now and then twice over!","questCompressionMegaName":"Mega Squash","questCompressionMegaDescription":"Right, the big one: 1 Mega Compressed Messy Stone [[Mega Compressed Messy Stone]]. Only the most stubborn miner could make it. Lucky for me, that\'s you! Keep that Compactor Pickaxe swinging.","questCompressionMegaGatherName":"Collect 531,441 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]","questCompressionMegaGather":"Mine Stone [[Stone]] at Ruby\'s Rockpile until you have 531,441 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]. Don\'t let the rock win now!","questCompressionMegaDelivery":"Bring Ruby 1 Mega Compressed Messy Stone [[Mega Compressed Messy Stone]]","questCompressionMegaCompleted":"You did it! I\'ve never held stone squashed this tight, and you made it. Stubborn rock? You were more stubborn! You\'ve earned my own prized pickaxe, friend. It breaks whole chunks of stone and ore at once, and some of that stone comes out squashed. Look after it for me!","questFarmingFirstHandInDescription":"Bring the Wheat [[Wheat]] back to me when you\'re ready, dear. There\'s no rush.","questFarmingFirstCollect":"Harvest 12 Wheat [[Wheat]]","questFarmingSecondHandInDescription":"Bring the Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] to me, dear. There\'s no hurry.","questFarmingDailyCompleted":"Thank you, dear. A lovely harvest. Here\'s a little something for your help.","questFarmingDailyDone":"That\'s today\'s harvest in, dear. Come and see me again tomorrow.","questFarmingDailyWheat":"Good to see you, dear. Could you bring me 16 Wheat [[Wheat]] today?","questFarmingDailyWheatCollect":"Harvest 16 Wheat [[Wheat]]","questFarmingDailyWheatDelivery":"Bring Tillie 16 Wheat [[Wheat]]","questFarmingDailyPotatoes":"I\'m making a stew today, dear. Could you bring me 12 Raw Potatoes [[Raw Potato]]?","questFarmingDailyPotatoesCollect":"Harvest 12 Raw Potatoes [[Raw Potato]]","questFarmingDailyPotatoesDelivery":"Bring Tillie 12 Raw Potatoes [[Raw Potato]]","questFarmingDailyCrops":"Bring me 16 Wheat [[Wheat]] or Raw Potatoes [[Raw Potato]] today, dear. The bare soil they leave will grow back into grass in a few moments.","questGroundworkGrassDelivery":"Bring Tillie 10 Grass Block [[Grass Block]]","questGroundworkGrassHandIn":"Bring your 10 Grass Block [[Grass Block]] back to me at Tillie\'s Patch, dear.","questGroundworkGrassReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Grass Block [[Grass Block]] from around my patch, dear.","questGroundworkGrassTurnIn":"Those will make a lovely green edge. Now gather 20 Dirt [[Dirt]] from the bare ground beside me, dear, so I can fill the low spots.","questGroundworkDirtCollect":"Gather 20 Dirt [[Dirt]]","questGroundworkDirtDescription":"Dig up 20 Dirt [[Dirt]] from the bare ground beside me at Tillie\'s Patch in the hub. That will give my patch a little room to grow. Keep the spade for your own garden.","miningGoblinGreeting":"Oi, pal! Come to gawp at my beauties? Gawping\'s free. Riding ain\'t.","miningGoblinIdle":"A deal\'s a deal, pal. My beauties are yours to ride, as often as you like.","miningGoblinNotYet":"Oi, pal! Old Crag says who works in his mine, and he hasn\'t said you. Get his say-so at the mine door, then come and talk business.","miningGoblinInventoryFull":"Your pockets are stuffed, pal! Make some room before I pay you.","questMiningCannonsName":"Over the Gap","questMiningCannonsDescription":"When that meteor hit, this bridge dropped right into the lava, pal. Now all that lovely Moonstone Ore [[Moonstone Ore]] is stuck on the far side. Lucky for you, I\'ve set up two cannons, one on each side of the gap! My beauties need powder, though. Fetch me 20 Coal [[Coal]].","questMiningCannonsCoalCollect":"Gather 20 Coal [[Coal]]","questMiningCannonsCoal":"Mine 20 Coal [[Coal]] for me at Ruby\'s Rockpile in the hub, or by the entrance to this mine, pal.","questMiningCannonsCoalDelivery":"Bring Grubnik 20 Coal [[Coal]]","questMiningCannonsCoalHandIn":"Bring your 20 Coal [[Coal]] to me by the broken bridge, pal.","questMiningCannonsCoalReminder":"{{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]], pal. No powder, no boom!","questMiningCannonsCoalTurnIn":"That\'s my powder sorted! Now for my fee. Cannons don\'t fire for free, pal, and I only take gold. Go and mine me 50 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] in the Gilded Gallery.","questMiningCannonsGoldName":"Mine 50 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]]","questMiningCannonsGold":"Break Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery, high up in this mine, until you\'ve got 50 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]], pal. Any Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] you already have count too.","questMiningCannonsGoldReminder":"{{remaining}} more Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]], pal. I can almost smell it!","questMiningCannonsSmeltName":"Smelt 50 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]","questMiningCannonsSmelt":"Smelt your Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] into 50 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] with 50 Coal [[Coal]] in a Furnace [[Furnace]]. There are a few about this mine. I only take my gold shiny, pal!","questMiningCannonsBarsDelivery":"Bring Grubnik 50 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]","questMiningCannonsBarsHandIn":"Bring the 50 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to me by the broken bridge, pal. No spending them on the way!","questMiningCannonsBarsReminder":"{{remaining}} more Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]], pal. A deal\'s a deal!","questMiningCannonsCompleted":"Ooh, look at them gleam! Bring me 4 fish today. No Darters [[Darter]], mind. Catch a Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]], a Sunset Minnow [[Sunset Minnow]], a Red Strongfish [[Red Strongfish]] and a Boomerang Fish [[Boomerang Fish]] in any water here in the hub, matey.","questKnotHandIn":"Thank you, matey! Straight into my bucket.","questFirstKnotWheatfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]]. The commonest bite in these waters, and the first worth knowing.","questFirstKnotSunsetMinnowDescription":"Catch or bring a Sunset Minnow [[Sunset Minnow]]. Small and quick, and coloured like the evening sky.","questFirstKnotRedStrongfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Red Strongfish [[Red Strongfish]]. It pulls hard, so hold your line firm.","questFirstKnotBoomerangFishDescription":"Catch or bring a Boomerang Fish [[Boomerang Fish]]. Odd-shaped thing, and the shyest of these four, so keep casting, matey.","questFirstKnotReportDescription":"Got all four? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.","questFirstKnotCompleted":"All four fish, and your first knot tied. Thank you, matey. Take this Knotted Rod. Now and then it brings up two fish at once.","questFirstKnotWheatfish":"Catch or bring a Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]]","questFirstKnotSunsetMinnow":"Catch or bring a Sunset Minnow [[Sunset Minnow]]","questFirstKnotRedStrongfish":"Catch or bring a Red Strongfish [[Red Strongfish]]","questFirstKnotBoomerangFish":"Catch or bring a Boomerang Fish [[Boomerang Fish]]","questKnotReport":"Report back to Blubberbeard","questBowlineName":"The Bowline","questBowlineDescription":"You have the feel of the line now, matey. Next: a Darter [[Darter]], a Root Flounder [[Root Flounder]], a Greenfin Loach [[Greenfin Loach]], a Green Strongfish [[Green Strongfish]] and a shy Seahorse [[Seahorse]]. Cast in any water here in the hub.","questBowlineDarterDescription":"Catch or bring a Darter [[Darter]]. Quick as an arrow, but it bites often.","questBowlineRootFlounderDescription":"Catch or bring a Root Flounder [[Root Flounder]]. Flat as a plank and brown as an old root.","questBowlineGreenfinLoachDescription":"Catch or bring a Greenfin Loach [[Greenfin Loach]]. Slippery, so reel it in quickly.","questBowlineGreenStrongfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Green Strongfish [[Green Strongfish]]. Cousin to the Red, and it puts up a real fight.","questBowlineSeahorseDescription":"Catch or bring a Seahorse [[Seahorse]]. The shyest bite yet, so be patient, matey.","questBowlineReportDescription":"Got all five? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.","questBowlineCompleted":"Five more fish, and a fine Bowline tied. Thank you, matey. Take this Bowline Rod. Fish bite on it sooner, and it brings up two at once more often.","questBowlineDarter":"Catch or bring a Darter [[Darter]]","questBowlineRootFlounder":"Catch or bring a Root Flounder [[Root Flounder]]","questBowlineGreenfinLoach":"Catch or bring a Greenfin Loach [[Greenfin Loach]]","questBowlineGreenStrongfish":"Catch or bring a Green Strongfish [[Green Strongfish]]","questBowlineSeahorse":"Catch or bring a Seahorse [[Seahorse]]","questAnchorBendName":"The Anchor Bend","questAnchorBendDescription":"Now for some stronger fish, matey, and shyer ones too, so settle in for a longer wait: a Spined Stickleback [[Spined Stickleback]], a Moon Strongfish [[Moon Strongfish]], a Boulder Bass [[Boulder Bass]] and a Grass Snapper [[Grass Snapper]]. Cast in any water here in the hub.","questAnchorBendSpinedSticklebackDescription":"Catch or bring a Spined Stickleback [[Spined Stickleback]]. Prickly little thing, so hold on tight.","questAnchorBendMoonStrongfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Moon Strongfish [[Moon Strongfish]]. Pale as the moon, and strong as its cousins.","questAnchorBendBoulderBassDescription":"Catch or bring a Boulder Bass [[Boulder Bass]]. Heavy as a rock, so pull with all you have.","questAnchorBendGrassSnapperDescription":"Catch or bring a Grass Snapper [[Grass Snapper]]. It snaps quickly, so be ready.","questAnchorBendReportDescription":"Got all four? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.","questAnchorBendCompleted":"Four strong fish, and the Anchor Bend tied. Thank you, matey. Take this Anchor Rod. Fish bite on it a touch sooner, and rare fish bite on it far more often.","questAnchorBendSpinedStickleback":"Catch or bring a Spined Stickleback [[Spined Stickleback]]","questAnchorBendMoonStrongfish":"Catch or bring a Moon Strongfish [[Moon Strongfish]]","questAnchorBendBoulderBass":"Catch or bring a Boulder Bass [[Boulder Bass]]","questAnchorBendGrassSnapper":"Catch or bring a Grass Snapper [[Grass Snapper]]","questFishermansKnotName":"The Fisherman\'s Knot","questFishermansKnotDescription":"In all my years I\'ve seen a Crystalized Wheatfish [[Crystalized Wheatfish]] and a Moonstone Pupfish [[Moonstone Pupfish]] only a handful of times. Catch me one of each, matey.","questFishermansKnotCrystalizedWheatfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Crystalized Wheatfish [[Crystalized Wheatfish]]. It can slip off the hook, so hold on tight.","questFishermansKnotMoonstonePupfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Moonstone Pupfish [[Moonstone Pupfish]], the rarest fish in these waters. Be quick when it bites.","questFishermansKnotReportDescription":"Got them both? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.","questFishermansKnotCompleted":"Both of them! Few anglers ever see those, matey. Thank you. Take this Fisherman\'s Rod. Fish bite on it quicker than on any rod I\'ve given you, one catch in four brings up a second fish, and rare fish bite on it just as often as on your Anchor Rod.","questFishermansKnotCrystalizedWheatfish":"Catch or bring a Crystalized Wheatfish [[Crystalized Wheatfish]]","questFishermansKnotMoonstonePupfish":"Catch or bring a Moonstone Pupfish [[Moonstone Pupfish]]","woodyQuestGreeting":"You\'re back. Come and talk when you\'re ready.","catnissQuestGreeting":"Ah, my favourite challenger returns! Come, let us talk.","digoryQuestGreeting":"There you are, friend! Come and have a word.","gillQuestGreeting":"Hello again, dear. Come and have a chat when you\'re ready.","blubberbeardQuestGreeting":"Ahoy, matey! Come and have a word with old Blubberbeard.","grimbaldQuestGreeting":"You. Human. Over here.","grimbaldInventoryFull":"Your pack\'s full. Make room, then talk to me.","questTroubleBelowName":"Trouble Below","questTroubleBelowDescription":"Meteors fall on Cragrock Mines all the time, but a big one has just struck. My mum Sapphire lives there, and they need every pair of hands. The old portal at the back of my Rockpile has a Portal Guardian charging {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head. Go and see Up Dog at the hub\'s Market first; he\'ll help you sell your way there.","questTroubleBelowLearnedDescription":"Meteors fall on Cragrock Mines all the time, but a big one has just struck. My mum Sapphire lives there, and they need every pair of hands. The old portal at the back of my Rockpile has a Portal Guardian charging {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head. I can smell Up Dog on you from here, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare and pay him!","questTroubleBelowFreeDescription":"Meteors fall on Cragrock Mines all the time, but a big one has just struck. My mum Sapphire lives there, and they need every pair of hands. The Portal Guardian at the back of my Rockpile will let you through the old portal. Go on, they\'re waiting!","questTroubleBelowMarket":"Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub","questTroubleBelowMarketDescription":"Visit Up Dog at the hub\'s Market. He\'ll show you how to sell spare ore for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.","questTroubleBelowMarketLearned":"You smell like Up Dog, friend, so you\'ve found the Market already. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].","questTroubleBelowPortal":"Use the cyan portal to Cragrock Mines","questTroubleBelowPortalDescription":"Toll paid! Step through the cyan portal at the back of my Rockpile to reach Cragrock Mines.","questTroubleBelowFreePortalDescription":"Step through the cyan portal at the back of my Rockpile to reach Cragrock Mines.","questTroubleBelowGrimbald":"Speak to Elder Crag at the mine entrance","questTroubleBelowGrimbaldDescription":"Find Elder Crag by the mine entrance and tell him I sent you. Don\'t take his grumbling to heart!","questTroubleBelowMeeting":"Ruby sent me a human? Hmph. I asked for help, not sightseers. That big meteor took half our tunnels and most of our nerve, so you\'ll have to do.","questIntoTheInfernosName":"Into the Wild Infernos","questIntoTheInfernosDescription":"You\'ve earned this, duellist. Past the old frame at the far end of The Badlands lie the Wild Infernos, the desert where Mini and I grew up. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, so see Up Dog at the hub\'s Market first. He\'ll help you sell your way there.","questIntoTheInfernosLearnedDescription":"You\'ve earned this, duellist. Past the old frame at the far end of The Badlands lie the Wild Infernos, the desert where Mini and I grew up. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, and you know the Market already. Sell your spoils and pay him!","questIntoTheInfernosFreeDescription":"You\'ve earned this, duellist. Past the old frame at the far end of The Badlands lie the Wild Infernos, the desert where Mini and I grew up. Its Portal Guardian will let you through. Go on, the desert awaits!","questIntoTheInfernosMarket":"Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub","questIntoTheInfernosMarketDescription":"Visit Up Dog at the hub\'s Market. He\'ll show you how to sell your spoils for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.","questIntoTheInfernosMarketLearned":"You\'ve met Up Dog already, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].","questIntoTheInfernosPortal":"Use the red portal to the Wild Infernos","questIntoTheInfernosPortalDescription":"Toll paid! Step through the red portal at the far end of The Badlands to reach the Wild Infernos.","questIntoTheInfernosFreePortalDescription":"Step through the red portal at the far end of The Badlands to reach the Wild Infernos.","questIntoTheInfernosAshhorn":"Speak to Elder Ashborn in the outpost","questIntoTheInfernosAshhornDescription":"Find Elder Ashborn in Emberwatch Outpost, beside the portal, and tell him I sent you. He taught Mini and me everything we know, so mind your manners!","questIntoTheInfernosMeeting":"Lorenzo\'s student? Then you are welcome here, traveller. Humans and minotaurs share this outpost, the only safe ground for miles. The desert beyond our walls is cruel, but its fire is sacred. Walk it with respect.","questIntoTheReachName":"Into the Lantern Reach","questIntoTheReachDescription":"You\'ve a real angler\'s hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I\'ve never been back. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, so see Up Dog at the hub\'s Market first. He\'ll help you sell your way there.","questIntoTheReachLearnedDescription":"You\'ve a real angler\'s hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I\'ve never been back. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, and you know the Market already. Sell what you can spare and pay him!","questIntoTheReachFreeDescription":"You\'ve a real angler\'s hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I\'ve never been back. The Portal Guardian will let you through. Go and see it for me.","questIntoTheReachMarket":"Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub","questIntoTheReachMarketDescription":"Visit Up Dog at the hub\'s Market. He\'ll show you how to sell spare resources for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.","questIntoTheReachMarketLearned":"You\'ve met Up Dog already, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].","questIntoTheReachPortal":"Use the blue portal to the Lantern Reach","questIntoTheReachPortalDescription":"Toll paid! Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.","questIntoTheReachFreePortalDescription":"Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.","questIntoTheReachKeeper":"Speak to Stinky at the lighthouse","questIntoTheReachKeeperDescription":"Follow the jetty from the harbour to the lighthouse on its rock. You\'ll smell old Stinky before you see him! Tell him Blubberbeard sent you, and that I\'m sorry.","questIntoTheReachMeeting":"Blubberbeard sent you? My old apprentice... Tell him there\'s nothing to forgive. Welcome to the Lantern Reach, friend. Everyone here calls me Stinky, and you\'ll soon smell why! The Lamp has been dark a long while, and the fish sleep deep without its light. But a good angler might just wake them.","keeperWickNothingToDo":"Sit a while and watch the water, friend. Upwind of me, if you like. Every ripple has a story.","keeperWickQuestGreeting":"Ah, a visitor! Come into the light, such as it is. Don\'t mind the flies, they\'re old friends.","keeperWickInventoryFull":"Your pack is full to the brim, friend. Make some room and come back.","lanternReachHush":"This water is still. Only small fry bite here until Stinky\'s lens shines on it.","questKeeperWickLensHandIn":"Ah, look at it glow! Thank you, friend.","questKeeperWickLensReport":"Report back to Stinky","questKelpwoodLensName":"The Kelpwood Lens","questKelpwoodLensDescription":"The lagoon fish still carry a little of the old light. Catch me a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]], a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]], an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]] and a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]] here in the lagoon, and their glow will relight the lens that faces Kelpwood.","questKelpwoodLensReportDescription":"Got all four? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questNothingToForgiveName":"Nothing to Forgive","questNothingToForgiveDescription":"The Lamp is waking at last, and its light reaches further every day. Would you carry a message for an old Keeper, friend? My apprentice never heard my answer. Tell Blubberbeard there\'s nothing to forgive, and that the Lamp burns again.","questNothingToForgiveTell":"Tell Blubberbeard in the Hub","questNothingToForgiveTellDescription":"Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and give him Stinky\'s answer.","questNothingToForgiveCompleted":"He said that? Nothing to forgive... I\'ve carried that guilt since I was a lad, matey. And the Lamp burns again! Here, take these two Glowtide Flares I\'ve kept since I left. Light one over Reach water and think of an old Keeper.","questKelpwoodLensCompleted":"Look, friend! The west lens is burning again, and its beam has reached Kelpwood. The fish there are waking already. Take my old Tidelight Rod. Its line still holds a little of the Lamp\'s light, so fish bite on it quicker and two at a time more often.","questAmethystLensName":"The Amethyst Lens","questAmethystLensDescription":"Kelpwood is waking, and its big fish glow brighter than anything in the lagoon. Catch me a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]], a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]], a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]], a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]] and an Oarfish [[Oarfish]] in Kelpwood\'s water, west across the bridge, and we\'ll light the lens that faces the Amethyst shoals.","questAmethystLensReportDescription":"Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questAmethystLensCompleted":"Two lenses lit! The east beam has reached the Amethyst shoals, and the crystals are humming. This Glowglass Rod has a chip of the Kelpwood lens for a float, and fish come to it sooner.","questMoonwellLensName":"The Moonwell Lens","questMoonwellLensDescription":"Now the lens that faces the Moonwell, where the oldest fish sleep. It needs the brightest catches in the Reach. Catch me an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]], a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]], a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]], a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]] and a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]] in the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge.","questMoonwellLensReportDescription":"Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questMoonwellLensCompleted":"Three beams across the water, friend! The Moonwell is stirring at last. Take the Moonwell Rod. It\'s cut from amethyst and cooled in that very pool, and the deepest fish rise to it.","questKelpwoodLensHatchetfish":"Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]","questKelpwoodLensHatchetfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]. A thin silver thing that glints when it turns. The lagoon is full of them.","questKelpwoodLensPolarflash":"Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]","questKelpwoodLensPolarflashDescription":"Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]. It still sparks a little in the lagoon\'s dark water. Quick on the hook!","questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnow":"Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]","questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnowDescription":"Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]. Pale as mist, and the gentlest bite in the lagoon.","questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouper":"Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]","questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouperDescription":"Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]. It hides on the lagoon floor and rarely bites, so be patient.","questAmethystLensArapaima":"Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]","questAmethystLensArapaimaDescription":"Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]. Big and slow, with a back as green as the kelp it hides in.","questAmethystLensStingray":"Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]","questAmethystLensStingrayDescription":"Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]. It glides low through the mangrove roots. Reel it in steadily.","questAmethystLensSawfish":"Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]","questAmethystLensSawfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]. Mind its nose! It fights hard all the way in from Kelpwood\'s channels.","questAmethystLensSturgeon":"Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]","questAmethystLensOarfish":"Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]","questAmethystLensSturgeonDescription":"Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]. The oldest fish in Kelpwood, and a shy one.","questAmethystLensOarfishDescription":"Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]. Long as a jetty and rarely seen. Keep casting in Kelpwood\'s water, and it will come.","questMoonwellLensEel":"Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]","questMoonwellLensEelDescription":"Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]. It crackles with light of its own down in the shoals. Just the thing for a lens!","questMoonwellLensDarter":"Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]","questMoonwellLensDarterDescription":"Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]. Quick as a shadow between the crystals. Watch your float closely.","questMoonwellLensMoray":"Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]","questMoonwellLensMorayDescription":"Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]. It hides in the crystal cracks and bites hard when it does.","questMoonwellLensDragonfish":"Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]","questMoonwellLensGiantMoray":"Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]","questMoonwellLensDragonfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]. It shines like moonlight on the Amethyst shoals.","questMoonwellLensGiantMorayDescription":"Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]. The biggest hunter in the shoals, and the rarest bite of all. Patience, friend.","questTheHushName":"The Hush","questTheHushDescription":"Three lenses lit, and still the Lamp won\'t wake fully. That\'s the Hush, friend. It\'s no curse, only a great old fish that fell asleep in the Moonwell when the light went out, and the whole Reach went quiet with it. Will you call it up for me? Gently, now. It only needs waking.","questTheHushCall":"Wait for the Hush in the Moonwell without reeling in","questTheHushCallDescription":"Cast into the Moonwell, north across the bridge from the Lamp, and keep still while you wait: a tap or click reels the line in. When the Hush rises, tap to bring it up and it will swim home.","questTheHushReturn":"Return to Stinky","questTheHushReturnDescription":"The Hush is home in the deep again. Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.","questTheHushCompleted":"There! Do you see it? The whole Lamp is shining, friend, brighter than I\'ve seen it since I was young. The Hush was never our enemy. It only needed someone patient enough to call it up and let it be. Take these five Glowtide Flares, and fish the Moonwell whenever you like. That old fish may come up to say hello.","questLanternReachMailName":"News of the Lantern Reach","questLanternReachMailDescription":"There you are! The portal to the Lantern Reach can finally be opened. Blubberbeard grew up out there, and he\'s been staring at that portal all week. Go and ask him about it!","questAskBlubberbeardAboutReach":"Ask Blubberbeard about the Lantern Reach","questAskBlubberbeardAboutReachDescription":"Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and take on his task to reach the Lantern Reach.","kelpwoodResidentQuestGreeting":"There you are, dear. I was hoping you\'d drift by.","kelpwoodResidentInventoryFull":"Your pockets are full, dear. Make a little room, and I\'ll give you what I owe you.","questLostPoolName":"The Lost Pool","questLostPoolDescription":"When I was young, dear, there was a pool hidden among these roots, where the kelp meets the cliff. The wisps still whisper of it. Would you find it and catch 3 fish there? I\'d so like to know it\'s still alive.","questLostPoolCatch":"Catch 3 fish in Kelpwood\'s hidden pool","questLostPoolCatchDescription":"Search Kelpwood\'s west rim, behind the trees on the far side from its bridge, for a crack of hidden water. Cast into it and land 3 fish.","questLostPoolReturn":"Return to Auntie Glenda","questLostPoolReturnDescription":"The old pool is still full of fish. Go and tell Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood\'s roots.","questLostPoolCompleted":"Still full of fish, after all these years... Thank you, dear. I feel a little lighter, as if the mist has thinned. Take these Glowtide Flares, and the [[Gold Coin]] that washed into my roots.","kelpwoodResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival at the Lamp? Oh, dear, I haven\'t been to one in a hundred years. I\'ll drift across the water as soon as the lanterns are lit.","amethystResidentQuestGreeting":"You came back! I\'ve got a really important job for you.","amethystResidentInventoryFull":"Your bag\'s too full! Make some room, then come back. I\'ve got something for you!","questPerfectPitchName":"Perfect Pitch","questPerfectPitchDescription":"When the Lamp\'s beam shines on my crystals, the fish swim up to listen! I want to hear them sing. Catch 3 fish where the beam touches the Amethyst water, and I\'ll tune to their song.","questPerfectPitchCatch":"Catch 3 fish where the Lamp\'s beam touches the Amethyst water","questPerfectPitchCatchDescription":"Find the column of light where the Lamp\'s beam touches the Amethyst water. It drifts across the water and rests now and then, so cast into it and keep your float in its light until the bite. Land 3 fish bitten there.","questPerfectPitchReturn":"Return to Urchin","questPerfectPitchReturnDescription":"The shoal sang in the beam\'s light. Go and tell Urchin by his dock hut.","questPerfectPitchCompleted":"Listen... every crystal is singing the same song! You did it! Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]]. And tell Stinky he still hums flat. Don\'t say it was me!","amethystResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival? With music?! I\'ll tune every crystal on the shoals. Can I stay up for the lanterns?","moonwellResidentQuestGreeting":"Softly... oh, it\'s you. Come and sit by the well.","moonwellResidentInventoryFull":"Your pack is full... make a little room, and I\'ll give you what I promised.","questGlowtideLullabyName":"Glowtide Lullaby","questGlowtideLullabyDescription":"When the glowtide drifts over the Moonwell, the sleeping fish rise to dream in its glow. Would you catch 40 of them there for me? Then I\'ll know what they\'re dreaming, and what to sing.","questGlowtideLullabyCatch":"Catch 40 fish in a glowtide bloom on the Moonwell","questGlowtideLullabyCatchDescription":"Find a glowing glowtide bloom on the Moonwell\'s water, cast into it and land 40 fish while your float is in its glow. A Glowtide Flare calls up a bloom of your own.","questGlowtideLullabyReturn":"Return to Hesper","questGlowtideLullabyReturnDescription":"The Moonwell\'s fish rose to the glow. Go and tell Hesper at the Moonwell.","questGlowtideLullabyCompleted":"They dream of the light... every one of them. I\'ll sing them something new tonight. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and keep the Moonwell glowing.","moonwellResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival at the Lamp... I\'ll bring my lantern, and sing the fish to sleep after. Wake me if I doze off.","pimLampFestivalInvited":"A festival?! At the Lamp?! I\'ll hang the bunting! I\'ll bake! Oh, I\'ve waited my whole life for this!","questLampFestivalInvitedBlubberbeard":"A festival at the Lamp, and old Stinky asked for me? ...Tell him I\'ll be there, matey. It\'s high time I went home.","questLampFestivalName":"The Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalDescription":"The whole Lamp is shining, friend, and every island is awake again. Time we had a Lamp Festival, like the ones I knew as a boy! Will you invite everyone for me? Start with Auntie Glenda, over on Kelpwood.","questLampFestivalRose":"Invite Rose to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalRoseDescription":"Back to the harbour now. Find Rose by her Tide Ledger and invite her to the Lamp Festival. She\'ll want to bake.","questLampFestivalGlenda":"Invite Auntie Glenda to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalGlendaDescription":"Find Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood\'s roots, west across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalChime":"Invite Urchin to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalChimeDescription":"Find Urchin by his dock hut on the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge, and invite him to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalHesper":"Invite Hesper to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalHesperDescription":"Find Hesper at the Moonwell, north across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalBlubberbeard":"Invite Blubberbeard to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalBlubberbeardDescription":"Everyone in the Reach is coming. Go back through the portal to the Hub, find Blubberbeard by his shack, and invite him home to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalReturn":"Return to Stinky","questLampFestivalReturnDescription":"Blubberbeard is coming home! Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.","questLampFestivalCompleted":"Blubberbeard\'s coming home? Oh, friend... I never stopped keeping a light on for him. Look at the Reach tonight: every island lit, and all of us together again. You did this. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and come to every festival we ever have.","keeperWickHushWaitShh":"Shh... Keep still and let the line rest, friend.","keeperWickHushWaitStill":"Still now. Something old is stirring...","keeperWickHushWaitNearly":"Nearly... It\'s rising to you.","keeperWickHushWaitAbandoned":"Shh... it\'s still close. Cast again and keep still.","keeperWickHushReelLost":"Oh! It slipped back down, friend. Cast again, it\'s still close.","keeperWickHushWaitInterrupted":"The Hush is still close, friend. Cast again when you\'re ready.","keeperWickKeepersChairLocked":"Not yet, friend. The Keeper\'s Chair waits until the whole Lamp is awake.","keeperWickKeepersChairWelcome":"Sit a while, friend. Turn the Lamp toward any water you\'ve lit, and it will shine a little kinder there, just for you.","keepersChairTitle":"Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairClose":"Close the Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairPrompt":"Sit in the Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairRopeUp":"Climb to the lantern room","keepersChairRopeDown":"Climb down","keepersChairKelpwood":"Kelpwood","keepersChairAmethyst":"Amethyst Shoals","keepersChairMoonwell":"Moonwell","keepersChairAim":"Aim the Lamp","keepersChairAimLabel":"Aim the Lamp at {{island}}","keepersChairAimed":"Lamp aimed","keepersChairRest":"Rest the Lamp","keepersChairDark":"Lens still dark","keepersChairTideNotice":"Today\'s Tide Notice","keepersChairFavour":"Aimed water: blooms hold more rares and last longer, and the Tide Notice fish bites more often.","keepersChairAimedStatus":"The Lamp shines on {{island}}.","keepersChairRestedStatus":"The Lamp rests, shining on every island alike.","keepersChairTooFar":"Climb to the lantern room to aim the Lamp.","keepersChairNotRelit":"Relight that island\'s lens first.","keeperWickReachLogWelcome":"My old logbook, friend. It smells of bait, like me! Land the biggest of each fish and I\'ll ink it in, bright as a beam.","keeperWickReachLogPageGold":"A whole page in gold! Not even the Lamp shines that bright. The Lamp keeps it safe for you.","keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseKelpwood":"A Kelpwood fish, hiding out in quiet water! The moment that beam touched the kelp, the mist lifted, and I\'m warm right through for the first time in years.","kelpwoodResidentGreeting":"Oh! Don\'t be frightened, dear. I\'m only tall.","kelpwoodResidentAsleepGreeting":"Oh! Don\'t be frightened, dear. I\'m only tall, and a touch misty while the water sleeps.","kelpwoodResidentAsleepTalk":"The kelp water has slept since the Lamp went dark, and the roots have grown so cold. Stinky at the Lamp knows how to relight Kelpwood\'s lens.","kelpwoodResidentWork":"I\'ve drifted through these roots for centuries. Some nights I can almost see the way on... then the mist closes again.","kelpwoodResidentFavouriteFish":"Ever landed a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]? Its green is the kelp of the first morning I remember, centuries ago.","amethystResidentHome":"Listen! The crystals are ringing again! I knew they would. Ding!","amethystResidentGreeting":"Oh! Hello! Tiptoe, please. The crystals are tuning.","amethystResidentAsleepGreeting":"Oh! Hello! Shh... the crystals haven\'t rung once since the light went out.","amethystResidentAsleepTalk":"My crystals won\'t ring without the Lamp\'s beam, and the fish won\'t come up to listen. It\'s sooo quiet! Ask Stinky how to relight the Amethyst lens. Please?","amethystResidentWork":"I tune all the crystals. All by myself! Hmm... that one\'s a teeny bit flat.","amethystResidentFavouriteFish":"An Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]] hums the perfect note! I tune my crystals to it. Bzzzz!","moonwellResidentHome":"Softly now... I stayed by the well through all the dark. Now the light\'s back, I can sing in it again.","moonwellResidentGreeting":"Softly now... the old fish are dreaming.","moonwellResidentAsleepGreeting":"Softly now... the whole Moonwell is asleep while the Lamp is dark.","moonwellResidentAsleepTalk":"I sing to the Moonwell every night, but its fish won\'t wake without the light. Perhaps Stinky could help you relight its lens...","moonwellResidentWork":"Lullay, little fins... The oldest fish sleep deep down there. I hum to them each night so they dream of the light.","moonwellResidentFavouriteFish":"A Glacial Lanternfish [[Glacial Lanternfish]] glows just like a little lamp. On dark nights, I wish I had one to sing by.","kelpwoodResidentLoanAsk":"Lend me your next Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]] from Kelpwood? I\'ll keep it a day for its warmth, then let it go.","kelpwoodResidentLoanAskPopup":"Lend Auntie Glenda your next Mossback Arapaima? It comes back with a gift once the day turns over.","kelpwoodResidentLoanAccepted":"Thank you, dear. Land one on Kelpwood and it will find its way to me.","kelpwoodResidentLoanWaiting":"Still hoping for that Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]. The crypt is stirring, but ask me again in a moment and I will send you down once more.","questSlayVulcanDescription":"You came through the fire? I\'m Ember. I felt a crack open in the world and followed it down. It\'s Lord Vulcan\'s doing, a wizard gone bad. He\'s been tearing it open from his tower at the bottom of the rift, and my fire only feeds him. His spells come in time, like a drum. Learn the beat and you can beat him. Bring friends if you can.","questSlayVulcanFightDescription":"Defeat Lord Vulcan in the ring at the bottom of the Molten Rift. His big spells come in time: step with the beat, or get out of the ring until they pass. Anyone fighting him beside you shares the win.","questSlayVulcanReportDescription":"Lord Vulcan is beaten! Tell Ember at the rift\'s southern edge.","questSlayVulcanCompleted":"You did it! Lord Vulcan is beaten, and the crack has gone quiet. But it isn\'t the only one. Head back to Flint in her booth at the end of the skull\'s tunnel.","questShootingGalleryCompleted":"Up on the ribs, toe to toe with them. Bold. The Magmaward Leggings are yours. Only the finest gold for my girl!","questHeartOfGoldGoldCollect":"Gather 16 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]","questHeartOfGoldGold":"Gather 16 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for the engine\'s golden heart.","questHeartOfGoldIronCollect":"Gather 8 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]","questHeartOfGoldIron":"Gather 8 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] for the engine\'s casing.","questHeartOfGoldCraftName":"Craft a Goldheart Engine [[Goldheart Engine]] at a Workbench","questHeartOfGoldCraft":"Craft a Goldheart Engine [[Goldheart Engine]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]] from your Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] and Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]].","questHeartOfGoldDelivery":"Bring the Goldheart Engine [[Goldheart Engine]] to Gabbro","questHeartOfGoldDeliver":"Bring the Goldheart Engine [[Goldheart Engine]] to Gabbro at his gold vein.","questHeartOfGoldReminder":"Still waiting on {{remaining}} Goldheart Engine [[Goldheart Engine]]!
